profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a Computer Science and Chemistry Background. Acquired skills in React.js, Angular, JavaScript, Express, Python, Node.js, and MongoDB through Texas Tech and Freelancing. Excited to always learn and build cool shi... i mean stuff! 

I specialize in building everything a website or app needs, making sure it works smoothly, and helping businesses and clients succeed. Discover how my skills can benefit you. I also love futbol, reggaeton and league of legends.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Scaled student capacity 3x without adding instructors by building an AI curriculum system
(Node.js/Express + GPT-4 API) that generates personalized learning paths and feedback, now serving
200+ students with the same teaching team.

◦ Reduced dashboard load time by 65% (2.3s → 800ms) by optimizing PostgreSQL queries and
pagination across 5,000+ student records, improving access speed for students and instructors.

◦ Built and shipped admin platform with role-based access control, replacing manual grading
workflows and enabling 5 instructors to manage 200+ students with 50% faster grading turnaround.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Saved $28,800/year by replacing third-party payroll software with custom internal system (Re-
act/Node.js/PostgreSQL) — built payment workflows, approval processes, and role-based dashboards
as sole engineer.

◦ Rebuilt document search system, reducing lookup time from 5s to under 200ms using PostgreSQL
full-text search, enabling field workers to instantly find client job records across 10,000+ documents.

◦ Eliminated 520 hours/year of manual call tracking by automating Zoom meeting data integration
into real-time analytics dashboards — leadership now gets instant reports instead of weekly spreadsheets.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · PostgreSQL · React.js · Back-End Web Development · Node.js

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Built and nurtured a cohesive full-stack development team, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.
• Implemented security best practices, resulting in a 15% reduction in vulnerabilities and enhancing the overall resilience of web applications.
• Spearheaded the upgrade of legacy codebases to modern technologies(React.js), ensuring compatibility with the latest frameworks and enhancing overall system performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development · HTML · Redux.js · PostgreSQL · GitHub · Web Design · Responsive Web Design · MongoDB

positions.title: Front End Supervisor
positions.description:
• Successfully increased customer data acquisition from 21% to 51% by implementing user-friendly assistance features, simplifying the process for customers to provide and recall information when reordering paint products.
• Developed and executed a time-efficient paint mixing process, reducing customer wait times
